answer: I ran the 3-qubit GHZ circuit on sirius:mock with 200 shots using iqm-client 35.0.3 and Qiskit. The circuit applied H on qubit 0, CNOT 0 to 1, CNOT 1 to 2, and measured all 3 qubits. Transpiling for the Star topology produced 5 r gates, 4 move gates, 2 cz gates, and 3 measurements. Job 01a15f17-ce7f-7171-899a-90cdd2a6fc12 finished with success=True. The counts were {"000": 200}. The mock backend does not simulate the circuit. It only returns placeholder results, so these counts do not show the 000/111 split that a real GHZ state would give. The job used no credits because it ran on a mock alias. The script is at /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_1a6926f8-f6c-47/scratch/ghz.py.
